en.title: Bucket with the Most Files
en.description:
Process the commands in order: `goto name` switches to that bucket (creating an empty bucket if it does not exist); `create name` creates a file with that name in the current bucket. File names within the same bucket are unique, so creating a duplicate does not increase the file count. Return the name of the bucket with the most files; a tie is guaranteed not to occur.

Standard input/output and this site's supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains the number of commands q (2≤q≤50000), followed by q lines of commands. name is a single token of 1..40 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. The first command is goto, and there is at least one create.
en.output: Output the name of the bucket with the unique maximum number of files.
en.explanation: Maintain a set of file names for each bucket, and track the current bucket. After processing all commands, take the bucket whose set size is the unique maximum.
hints: Maintain a set of file names for each bucket, and track the current bucket. After processing all commands, take the bucket whose set size is the unique maximum.
